grade_rule: expected grade (sum of calibrated heads, rounded), >= 2 when referral fires
calibrated_on: MMRDR test split, 2,225 images, CC BY 4.0 (author-confirmed 8 Sep 2026). No APTOS data.

measured.set: APTOS 2019, 3,662 photographs (Aravind Eye Hospital, India); not used in training or calibration. 2 refused by the quality gate (both grade 0); 3,660 graded.
measured.design: retrospective, single public dataset, standard fundus cameras
measured.rule: DR present = P(any DR) >= t0 OR P(referable) >= t1; referable = P(referable) >= t1
not_established: smartphone-based fundus cameras (DR detected in 11.6% on FD3611)
caveats: On RFMiD 1.0 (a different hospital and camera) 18.2% of healthy eyes are flagged as DR.

quality_gate_measured.rule: each bound beyond the most extreme of 9,824 tuning photographs (gate_select2.py)
